Public source-linked portfolio. Personal perspectives are not employer endorsements. Publication statuses and abstracts are source-reported; forthcoming and under-review works are not published papers. Illustrative graph emphasis is not measured impact. Simulations are educational, not live enterprise actions.

## Research
- [Agent Trust & Reputation | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/agent-trust-reputation): Evidence-based trust, contextual reputation and risk-aware permissions between autonomous agents.
- [Agentic AI Architecture | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/agentic-ai-architecture): Orchestration, coordination and evaluation for systems that plan, use tools and act.
- [AI Evaluation & Reliability | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/ai-evaluation-reliability): Scenario-based testing, traceable evidence and failure recovery for AI systems beyond the demo.
- [AI Security & Governance | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/ai-security-governance): Identity, least privilege and runtime controls for agents operating across enterprise boundaries.

- [Custom Java Hash Table | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/works/custom-java-hash-table): Educational hash map with linked collision chains, insertion, lookup and removal. No lock-free or thread-safety guarantee. Java · Separate chaining
- [Hadoop Distributed Social Network | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/works/hadoop-distributed-social-network): Multi-terabyte social graph processing on HDFS. Distributed · MapReduce
- [Load Testing of a Social Networking Application | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/works/load-testing-of-a-social-networking-application): Distributed multi-tenant simulation and real-time performance analytics. Granted · Patent No. 555747 · IP India
- [Publication bibliography | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/works/publication-bibliography): Explore the externally maintained citation list; this link is not an individual scholarly paper. Google Scholar · external bibliography
- [SkipList Probabilistic Index | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/works/skiplist-probabilistic-index): Layered probabilistic index without tree rebalancing. Algorithms · O(log N)
- [Tokenization & Porter Stemming Pipeline | Harsh Verma](https://www.iamharshverma.com/research/works/tokenization-porter-stemming-pipeline): Corpus tokenization, token-frequency counting and Porter stemming; this public code does not implement an inverted index. Text processing · Java
